description: Documented exceptions for known dependency security advisories evaluated as non-exploitable or accepted dev-tooling risks in the clips-frontend runtime environment.

exceptions.reason: Email provider is not enabled in production (OAuth Google/Apple/Twitter and Stellar WebAuthn are used exclusively). Email homoglyph issue is non-exploitable.
Existence-based fail open vulnerability in Auth.js is mitigated across the codebase by explicitly validating `session?.user?.id` rather than testing session object existence.
Windows-hosted Next.js server vulnerability. Production deployments execute exclusively on Linux container runtime environments (Fly.io, Kubernetes, Vercel).

Next.js AVIF image optimization advisory. In next.config.ts, remotePatterns are strictly restricted to trusted origins (AWS CloudFront, S3, Dicebear, Google, GitHub, Unsplash). Untrusted arbitrary user image domains are disallowed.
Bearer header handling is sanitized by custom apiAuthMiddleware prior to reaching Auth.js handlers.
PKCE check cookies are protected by strict sameSite and secure flags.
Vitest is strictly a devDependency used only during local testing and CI test execution. It is never included in client or production server bundles.
Test runner devDependency not bundled into production artifact.
Vitest browser mode provider devDependency for component testing in headless CI runner only.
Exposed Browser Mode API restricted to local test runner; not exposed on public network.
Test runner devDependency for headless browser tests in CI.
Headless browser testing adapter devDependency in CI runner only.
Mutation testing tooling devDependency; never executed in production.
Transitive devDependency pulled by storybook and vitest browser runner; not exposed on public production attack surface.
Transitive devDependency pulled by storybook dev server.
Transitive build-time image optimization dependency; Next.js remote pattern limits prevent arbitrary file processing.
Transitive dependency in @stellar/stellar-sdk used only for parsing local stellar.toml files, not exposed to untrusted user input.
Transitive dependency in @stellar/stellar-sdk used only for parsing local stellar.toml files.
Transitive devDependency in @lhci/cli for Lighthouse performance testing.
